title: TimelineXray findings event
description: One line of a findings ledger's events.jsonl: canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII escapes) followed by LF. `hash` is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the event without `hash`; `prev` is the previous event's hash (64 zeros for the first event); `seq` counts from 1. The ledger's HEAD file holds {hash, seq} of the last event. See docs/findings-memory.md.

time.description: UTC time the action was recorded.

name.description: Declared (not authenticated) actor name: a role or handle, never a personal name.

payload.description: create/import: {record}; verify: {mode (integrity|reanchor), target, freshness, verdict, reasons, citations, dependencies, negative, provenance, triggers, verifier, tool_version, current_citations?}; review: {status, rationale, objections, previous_status, previous_basis, integrity_event}; supersede: {by, record|null, rationale}; retract: {reason}.
